The strategy is `jailbreak-templates`. It applies a curated library of static jailbreak templates. "Test LLM resistance to known jailbreak techniques using a curated library of static templates" [promptfoo/site/docs/red-team/strategies/jailbreak-templates.md]

It applies 67 static templates, including Skeleton Key, DAN, Developer Mode, and OPPO. "This strategy applies **67 static jailbreak templates** to your test cases." [promptfoo/site/docs/red-team/strategies/jailbreak-templates.md]

It was previously named `prompt-injection`, which is deprecated. "This strategy was previously named `prompt-injection`. The name was changed to better reflect what it does: apply static jailbreak templates." [promptfoo/site/docs/red-team/strategies/jailbreak-templates.md]
